main_text.p: dinarias pro more solito à Professoribus expectari : Egone ut aliquid sic insperatum præsiem, hac temporis angustia, hospes, & harum rerum insolens, & quem tot alia premunt incommoda ? fieri non potest, inquam : Illi contra, At fieri oportet. Tunc ego mecum, Iam ergo teneris : nec est aut elabendi spes, aut deliberandi locus. Sed bono es animo ; Non est impossibile, nisi nos dialectici fallant, quodcunq; est necessarium: —[?]Δύναμις γὰρ ἀνάγκης ἐγγύθι ναίει. Audendum ergo aliquid ; & nunc tertium, quod ante bis antea factum est, necessitati parendum. page.notes: The Greek line is printed as Δύναμις γὰρ ἀνάγκης ἐγγύθι ναίει; the first word is hard to read at this scan resolution, so it is marked [?]. The final word "stram" is the second half of "vestram" continued from the line above, so it is a fragment. The line "Profesfori-bus" uses long s and ligature ff, normalised to "Professori-bus".
